name: 08-07-fix-git-status-race
title: fix: git status list stale after build (race in full refresh)
description: Bug #9: file list git status markers become stale after running a build. Root cause: git-changed listener fires refreshGitFileStates fire-and-forget; during a build, a slow in-flight fetch can resolve after a faster newer one, overwriting changed_files with a stale mid-build snapshot. Add staleness token so only the latest full refresh applies; debounce the git-changed listener; add build output dirs to watcher ignore list.
creator: tincopper
